messages:
Alex M.: quick heads-up — proposal to remove legacy header `X-Api-Key` from Partner API in the upcoming sdk v3.0. This affects marketplace integrations (AWS/GCP listings), HPE hardware partners, and 3 SIs.
Alex M.: suggested timeline: announce now, 90-day deprecation window, opt-in runtime flag `x-rw-legacy-auth` for the first 60 days for partners who need a soft fallback.
Sasha R.: 90 days feels tight for marketplace/legal approvals. can we do 120 for marketplace listings specifically? :thinking_face:
Mina Patel: for Dedicated/Private customers we can add a proxy shim to accept both headers for 3 months. infra effort ~1 engineer-week.
Paul Chen: we should provide an SDK migration helper and a small server-side compatibility shim. I'll sketch a migration CLI: `rw-migrate-auth --from x-api-key --to authorization` and own it.
Jen Ortiz: partner comms: need partner-specific message + copy for marketplace vendors. i can draft templates. also schedule a 30-min sync with partner PMs next week.
Alex M.: agreed on action items: 1) partner-facing deprecation doc (jen), 2) migration helper in SDK + changelog (paul), 3) proxy shim runbook for Dedicated (mina), 4) extended marketplace window to 120 days (sasha).
Sasha R.: also add explicit rollback criteria: error rate > 1% or integration failures > 0.5% across top-10 partners -> pause rollout.
Mina Patel: logging hooks: emit `x-rw-auth-migration` metric so we can track old header usage per partner id. will add to runtime telemetry.
Paul Chen: sample curl/snippet for partners (to include in doc):
```
# old
curl -H "X-Api-Key: <KEY>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# new
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Paul Chen: also add an env var and SDK opt-in to enable strict mode: `REDWOOD_AUTH_STRICT=true` so integrators can test earlier.
Jen Ortiz: drafting partner email now. will include migration steps, timeline (announce + 120d for marketplace, 90d for others), support contacts, and invitation to a migration office hour.
Alex M.: let's also do a limited canary: rollout 2% traffic to strict mode in week 1, 10% in week 2, monitor errors/latency and partner tickets. if anything spikes, auto-roll back to legacy-enabled.
partner-coord-bot: calendar invite created: "Partner Auth Header Migration — sync" Wed 09:30 PT — invitees: alex, sasha, jen, paul, mina. link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/invite/abc123
Sasha R.: noted. i'll raise a marketplace legal flag and loop in sales to give partners notice.
Alex M.: thanks — i'll open the partner-deprecation doc in the handbook and add the above plan. tagging follow-ups: @jen to finish copy by Fri, @paul to spike the migration CLI by EOD Tue, @mina to post telemetry dashboard by Wed. :thumbsup:
Jen Ortiz: copy done, posted at https://handbook.redwood.ai/partnerships/auth-deprecation-draft — feedback welcome.
Paul Chen: pushed initial migration helper to branch `auth-migrate` — PR by EOD.
Mina Patel: telemetry dashboard prototyped -> https://dash.redwood.ai/d/partners/auth-migration. added `x-rw-auth-migration` metric.
Alex M.: great progress. we'll use the sync to finalize partner roll cadence and who signs the marketplace notice. end thread.
